finding: CONSUMED FACT (activation COUNT): a sustained computer-use Enter hold on a focused TextBox host with a Default OkButton produced ONE TextBox1 KeyDown(13), then the default button's Enter -> Click -> KeyUp(13) -- the default button activates EXACTLY ONCE for the captured hold. Only ONE KeyDown surfaced (on TextBox1, before the focus transfer); no per-repeat KeyDown was logged on either control. oxforms-esq.15 consumes this activation-count fact by gating the default-button Enter activation on !KeyRepeat.is_repeat (mirrors the CheckBox toggle gate, esq.12), so OS auto-repeat Enter KeyDowns neither re-transfer focus nor re-Click. CAVEATS: (1) the hold duration (~2.5s, recorded as operator input metadata in input-actions.json) is NOT a worksheet observation -- the event log has no timestamp column. (2) Unlike the esq.12 held-Space capture (which ran TWO durations, 1.0s and 2.5s, to demonstrate invariance over hold time), this is a SINGLE hold; the single non-multiplying KeyDown is consistent with single activation but does not independently measure hold-time invariance. (3) it is not separately confirmed that the OS key-hold emitted repeat WM_KEYDOWNs; the single logged KeyDown is the evidence the activation does not multiply.
driving_method: Computer-use hold_key (genuine OS key-hold of Enter) on a background-COM-hosted Excel running the committed w008-held-key fixture; the fixture VBA logged events to the W008HeldKeyLog worksheet, exported to CSV. A SINGLE sustained hold was performed (duration recorded as operator input metadata in input-actions.json); unlike esq.12 no second duration was captured. Reuses the same fixture as the esq.12 held-Space capture (it already carries a Default OkButton set at runtime + OkButton Enter/Click/KeyDown/KeyUp handlers).
non_claims: Scenario coverage reports observed worksheet rows in this run only.
esq.15 consumes ONLY the activation-COUNT fact (one Click for the captured sustained hold).
Hold-time invariance was NOT separately measured across durations (unlike esq.12 which ran 1.0s AND 2.5s); a single hold was performed here.
The ~2.5s duration is operator input metadata (input-actions.json), not a worksheet observation -- the event log has no timestamp column.
It is not separately confirmed that the OS key-hold emitted repeat WM_KEYDOWNs; the single logged KeyDown is the evidence the activation does not multiply.
Held Escape (cancel button) and held Alt+accelerator activation repeat behavior were NOT captured and are not claimed.
No OxForms runtime behavior is claimed by the capture (oxforms-esq.15 consumes it).
